newsitem.title: UK: Halifax rebounds, sharp fall seen overdone.
newsitem.headline: Halifax rebounds, sharp fall seen overdone.

text.p: Shares in Halifax Plc recovered some of their recent sharp losses on Thursday as investors took the view the fall had been overdone, dealers said.
The shares were up 22p to 730 by 0955 GMT after easing from an earlier high of 735p. Volume was around five million shares.
"The feeling is that they were oversold down to the 7.00 pound level and were looking cheap," said one senior dealer.
Over the last two weeks the shares fell seven percent from 760p on July 16th to a low of 704p on Monday. The recently floated banking group closed at 735-1/2p on its June 2 market debut.
"People have seen it come down from 780p and they feel that at these levels, it has been overdone," another dealer commented.
